liebermann.notes: Manuscript once at Saint-Évroult, used by Ordericus Vitalis, mainly saints' lives largely of Anglo-Saxon origin, considered English; f. 109–16 Iudicium Dei X, printed by Martène and Zeumer, whose text Liebermann follows.

entries.text_de: Alençon 14, um 1100, einst in S. Évroult zu Ouches durch Ordericus Vitalis benutzt, enthält hauptsächlich Vitae sanctorum, besonders Angelsächsischer Herkunft4, u. a. Willibrord, Aethelwold, Birin, Swithun, doch auch Brendan, und gilt als Englisch. F. 109—16 Iudicium Dei X, s. u. S. 417, gedruckt von Martène und Zeumer, s. S. 401b, denen ich folge.
entries.text_en: Alençon 14, c. 1100, once used at Saint-Évroult in Ouche by Orderic Vitalis; contains chiefly Vitae sanctorum, especially of Anglo-Saxon origin4, among others Willibrord, Aethelwold, Birinus, Swithun, but also Brendan, and is held to be English. Ff. 109—16 Iudicium Dei X, see below, p. 417, printed by Martène and Zeumer, see p. 401b, whom I follow.

notes.text_de: vgl. Neues Archiv ält. Dt. Gesch. VI 188; Hardy Descr. cat. I 237. 464. 515. 587.
notes.text_en: cf. Neues Archiv ält. Dt. Gesch. VI 188; Hardy, Descr. cat. I 237. 464. 515. 587.

transcription.doubts: Superscript italic 'b' after 'S. 401' is a letter, not a footnote number (probably refers to a marked note or addendum on p. 401); kept as <sup>b</sup>.
